figures.caption: Fig. 1. Illustration of NeuroCodec architecture. A frozen DAC encoder extracts mixture latents Zmix, which are fused with EEG embeddings through stacked CM-S3 blocks to predict target latents Ztgt. The predicted latents are quantized via codebooks (Q1–Q9), and a frozen DAC decoder reconstructs the target speech waveform ŝ. The EEG encoder captures spatial-temporal neural features, and multi-period/multi-band discriminators provide adversarial supervision.

Fig. 2. Qualitative spectrogram comparison on the Cocktail Party dataset: (i) mixture, (ii) ground-truth target, (iii) M3ANet output, and (iv) NeuroCodec output. Solid boxes highlight NeuroCodec’s preserved content above 7 kHz, while dashed region mark overlapping-speech regions with reduced interference. Note that M3ANet does not preserve content above 7 kHz, nor does it avoid speaker leakage within the dashed region.
